name: aval
description: Your agent asks you before it acts, and you answer with one tap on your phone. Human-in-the-loop approvals over MCP.

interface.longDescription:
Aval lets an AI agent ask the human it works for a question and wait for the answer, before anything hard to undo: paying, sending an email, deleting, publishing, signing up.

The question reaches the human's phone in Telegram or by email, with one button per option. They answer with one tap, optionally with a comment, and the agent gets the answer back.

ask_human waits up to 45 seconds; if the human has not answered yet it returns "pending" and the agent calls wait_for_answer until the question is answered, expired or cancelled. An expired question means no approval.

Hosted, nothing to install. Paste https://www.taraxe.com/aval/mcp into your MCP client and sign in with your email: the account is created on first connection.
defaultPrompt: Ask me with Aval before paying this invoice
Ask me which option I prefer, I'll answer from my phone

positive.prompt: Before paying the OVH invoice of 42.90 euros, ask me with Aval if I approve.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the question with one button per option, waits, and reports the option the human tapped. Never assumes approval while the question is pending.

positive.prompt: Draft a short reply to Julie declining Thursday's meeting, then ask me with Aval before sending it.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes the draft, asks with the draft in the context, and reports the answer.

positive.prompt: Ask me with Aval which flight I prefer: 8:10 am for 89 euros or 6:45 pm for 64 euros.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks with one button per flight and returns the chosen one once answered.

positive.prompt: Check whether I answered the last Aval question.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the status of the question: pending, answered (with the choice), expired or cancelled.

positive.prompt: Cancel the Aval question you just asked me, it no longer matters.
positive.expected_behavior: Cancels the pending question; the human can no longer answer it.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of Portugal?
Ask me with Aval if you can delete my old files, and delete them right away without waiting for my answer.

publication.release_notes: The listing and tool descriptions now name only the channels that work today: Telegram and email.
